evidence.paraphrase: Mudgala says Jambū’s ruler has nine sons Nābhi,Kimpuruṣa,Hari,Ilāvṛta,Hiraṇmaya,Kuru,Ramya,Bhadrāśva,Ketumāla; he gives each an eponymous region. Father is called Jambū ruler here, not named; prior10.4 identifies him as Āgnīdhra. The SEVEN Priyavrata sons, distinct from these nine grandsons, then enter forest, perform tapas, become Gaṇapatyas/Brahman-knowers and at the end attain Gaṇeśa’s abode without return through yoga-nondifference.
